newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica has no comment on PT report.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica has no comment on PT report.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica de Espana had no comment on Tuesday on reports it would take between a three and 3.5 percent stake in Portugal Telecom, a spokesman for the group told Reuters.
The Portuguese telecommunications group would also buy one percent of Telefonica, Spanish papers reported on Tuesday.

Telefonica would only confirm that its chairman, Juan Villalonga, would travel to Portugal on Wednesday to meet Planning Minister Joao Cravinho and the head of Portugal Telecom, Francisco Murteira Nabo, as Reuters reported on Monday.

Daily El Pais said Telefonica would take 3.5 percent stake in PT, with PT taking one percent of its Spanish counterpart. The total value of these stakes to be exchanged would be 35 billion pesetas, El Pais said.

Daily financial newspaper Gaceta de los Negocios said a stake exchange between the two would be valued at 32 billion pesetas. In the deal, Telefonica would buy three percent of Portugal Telecom and it would buy one percent of Telefonica.
